# Security policy

## Supported versions

No version has been released yet. After the first release, fixes go into the
latest release only.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report vulnerabilities privately through GitHub's private vulnerability
reporting for this repository (Security tab, "Report a vulnerability"). Do not
open a public issue for a security problem.

A command that the tool sends although the documentation says it is refused
(for example a factory reset or a power-off without a working way back) counts
as a security problem.
